title: Connect libre2 with xdrip directly
symptom: User wants to connect Libre2 sensor with xDrip directly without using the patched app, and use the Libre reader during the day. They ask if it is possible and which data source option to choose.
cause: It is not possible to get data into xDrip+ without the patched app. Also, the sensor remembers the device it was started from, so if started with the patched app, the reader cannot be used for alarms or even reading.
fix: The thread suggests using the patched app and xDrip on a phone with the son, and xDrip on the parent's phone as a follower. Alternatively, the user decides to buy the Bubble (a transmitter) to use with xDrip.
evidence_quote: No, it isn't possible to get data into xDrip+ without the patched app. It might be possible in the future but it will never be possible to use it side-by-side with the Libre reader because either the app or the reader can use Bluetooth to communicate with the sensor.
